♈ Aries

🔥 Energy: With the Moon moving through early Taurus in Krittika in your 2nd house, today’s fire is grounded in practical concerns: what you can touch, build and secure. The Sun and retrograde Mercury have shifted deeper into Scorpio in your 8th house, pulling your attention to shared commitments, while Mars in Cancer and Jupiter in your 5th stir a need for both emotional safety and creative risk. Saturn in Pisces in your 12th asks you to quietly face what drains you. It’s a day to make concrete choices that support your peace of mind, not just your image.

💼 Career: Work matters favor slow, thorough action over impulsive leaps. The Taurus Moon highlights your skills and the tangible value you provide; you may feel compelled to show results instead of just enthusiasm. With Sun–Mercury retrograde in your 8th, behind-the-scenes discussions about budgets, approvals or shared projects may surface. This is ideal for clarifying clauses, revising proposals or cleaning up old obligations rather than pushing brand‑new deals. Mars in your 4th can make you sensitive to how work impacts home life—if you’re bringing tension back to your space, consider one concrete boundary you can set around time or availability.

❤️ Love: Emotional intensity is present, but it’s quieter than drama. The 8th-house Sun focuses relationships on trust, loyalty and how you share burdens. If partnered, you may feel ready to broach topics around responsibilities, emotional labor or how each of you supports the other during stress. Choose calm, grounded language; today is better for honest, steady conversation than big confrontations. If single, someone may reveal a more vulnerable side, or you might notice how safe you feel (or don’t) when you open up—let that guide who you invest in next.

💰 Money: The Moon in your 2nd puts finances front and center. You might feel an urge to stabilize things—pay off a small debt, renegotiate a recurring expense, or organize accounts. With Scorpio highlighting the 8th, shared money, loans or subscriptions linked to others deserve a second look. Mercury retrograde favors tracking down old paperwork or correcting a past oversight. Avoid impulsive big buys; instead, choose one or two practical upgrades that genuinely make life easier.

🧘 Advice: When your energy spikes today, channel it into one solid, useful task—paying a bill, fixing something, finishing a nagging chore—so your nervous system has proof that you’re taking care of what matters.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you turn your courage toward stabilizing your life, rather than just shaking it up, your fire stops burning bridges and starts building foundations.
taurus:
♉ Taurus

🔥 Energy: The Moon traveling through your own sign in Krittika lights up your 1st house, sharpening your senses and amplifying your preferences. You’re less willing to tolerate what feels flimsy or forced. Across the sky, the Sun and retrograde Mercury in Scorpio activate your 7th house, putting relationship dynamics under examination. Mars in Cancer and Jupiter in your 4th deepen your craving for emotional and physical comfort. Saturn in Pisces in your 11th reminds you to be discerning about which groups and future plans truly nourish you.

💼 Career: This is a strong day to quietly assert your way of doing things. The Taurus Moon gives you a steady presence; others may naturally look to you as the practical anchor in a situation. With Scorpio energy in your 7th, clients, collaborators or superiors might be more intense or probing than usual. Use Mercury retrograde to revisit agreements, meeting rhythms or expectations that no longer reflect reality. Rather than fighting, show how a different structure can benefit everyone. If a team or project feels chronically draining, Saturn nudges you to consider a gradual exit strategy or boundary.

❤️ Love: You’re more aware of how relationships affect your body—whether you relax or tense up around someone. The 7th-house Sun brings partnership matters to the foreground; real conversations about loyalty, honesty and long-term direction can be fruitful if you stay grounded. If attached, this is a good day to calmly name behaviors that feel supportive versus those that feel destabilizing, and to listen to your partner’s list too. If single, your attraction radar is sharp; you’re less swayed by charm and more by consistency and emotional depth.

💰 Money: With the Moon in your sign, you may feel protective of your resources and time. That’s healthy, as long as it doesn’t slip into scarcity panic. Focus on basics: food, shelter, necessary tools. The Scorpio 7th house emphasis can highlight shared costs, negotiations over fees, or how fairly you’re being compensated in partnerships. Mercury retrograde supports revising old terms or correcting imbalances. Avoid financial ultimatums; incremental adjustments work better with today’s energy.

🧘 Advice: Pay close attention to what your body says yes or no to—meals, people, tasks. Treat those signals as data for designing a more sustainable life, rather than as moods to override.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you stop apologizing for your steady pace and solid needs, you naturally attract people and plans that can actually last with you.
gemini:
♊ Gemini

If partnered, you might prefer quiet companionship over busy plans—cooking together, watching something soothing, or having a low-key check-in about how you’re both really doing. If single, you may feel less inclined to chase conversation for its own sake and more inclined to pull back from people who consistently leave you mentally tired. Someone who respects your need for downtime will stand out.

💰 Money: The 6th-house focus ties money closely to how you manage your energy each day. This is a good time to review recurring payments that seemed minor individually but add up, especially tied to work tools or subscriptions. The 12th-house Moon suggests you look for leaks—small indulgences, autopays, or favors that subtly strain your budget. Instead of drastic cuts, re-route a modest amount toward one clear goal: a buffer fund, a class, or a needed repair.

🧘 Advice: Give yourself more margin than you think you need—extra minutes between calls, a looser evening—to let your thoughts settle. Your best ideas today come from the quiet between tasks, not from cramming more in.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you protect your attention like a scarce resource, your mind stops feeling scattered and starts feeling strategic.
